Port strike ends after 11 days as union accepts new deal

By Maria Okafor

2 hours ago

Dockworkers will return to work on Monday after the union voted 71 to 29 to accept an offer that raises pay by 9 percent over three years, ending an eleven day stoppage.

Shipping lines said the backlog of about 140 vessels would take weeks to clear, and warned that some goods would arrive late.
